rust_summary: reading the client's world destination, sound-option sliders and screen-free playing state, and whether this `Game` is the window's (`native_client_world_key`, `native_sound_volume`, `native_sound_volume_effective`, `native_playing`, `native_window`).
doc_summary: Client state: `client_world_key()` returns the loaded client's save-folder basename, normalized server/LAN address, or `Friend` without the invite secret; none on the title screen, before a client level loads or on a server instance. A LAN host remains Singleplayer. `sound_volume(category)` reads the option slider; `sound_volume_effective(category)` multiplies by master (Master itself is not squared). Categories are Master, Music, Records, Weather, Blocks, Hostile, Neutral, Players, Ambient, Voice and Ui. `playing()` exposes the existing screen predicate: Playing with no title, sign editor or book, not a simulation-pause flag. `window()` is true in the window's `Game` and false in a server's (the integrated server included), so a hook that runs in both can tell them apart. All are reads and do not change audio or vanilla gameplay. Requires native hooks API @API:client_state_reads@.
